title: R1 Batch TG Comparison

asks.ask: 각 배치 200–450 °C 구간 질량 변화량(W200 − W450, wt%)을 계산해서 범례 라벨에 같이 넣어 주세요.

code:
import numpy as np
lines = ax1.get_lines()
handles, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = []
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    mask = ~np.isnan(x_data) & ~np.isnan(y_data)
    x_clean = x_data[mask]
    y_clean = y_data[mask]
    if len(x_clean) > 0:
        try:
            w200 = np.interp(200, x_clean, y_clean)
            w450 = np.interp(450, x_clean, y_clean)
            delta_w = w200 - w450
            orig_label = labels[i] if i < len(labels) else f'Sheet {i}'
            new_labels.append(f'{orig_label} (ΔW: {delta_w:.2f}%)')
        except Exception:
            new_labels.append(labels[i] if i < len(labels) else f'Sheet {i}')
    else:
        new_labels.append(labels[i] if i < len(labels) else f'Sheet {i}')
if handles:
    ax1.legend(handles=handles, labels=new_labels, loc='best')
